name: Lodi Gas Storage Lateral
researcher_notes: EIA August 2026 release, sheet Historical Projects (1996-2024), Excel row 210: Lodi Storage Field Lateral, operator Lodi Storage Inc, lateral, completed, in service November 2001, California, 33 miles, 24 inch, 500 MMcf/d, intrastate. No existing GEM row under any Lodi or Kirby Hills name (checked the 529-row US roster). EIA is one origin; no independent source found for the 33 mile figure. A California Public Utilities Commission project memo and a Kirby Hills environmental assessment describe 5.9 mile and 9 mile lines for the later Kirby Hills work and 24 inch pipe to PG&E, but none stated 33 miles, so they are not cited. Endpoints not confirmed (Lodi storage field near Thornton to PG&E interconnect). Owner not in gazetteer; spelled as EIA spells it, legal form unverified. Separate EIA row 410, Lodi (Kirby Hills) Lateral, 6 miles, is under the 25 km length rule. Passes length rule on EIA figure only; reviewer should seek a California regulator document. No route found.
